messages.en: I just wanted to say thanks for helping me out yesterday.
No problem, it was nothing. Just let me know if you need any more help.
I'm getting married next month. We're just having the ceremony at home.
Wow, congratulations! Have you set a date yet?
I'm enjoying my nasi lemak here. Let me eat in peace for a bit, okay?
Go ahead and eat. I just want to look at the menu.

senses.en_definition: To pass away; a gentler way of saying that someone has died.

messages.en: Nadia, Farah's dad passed away yesterday. Her older sister just told me.
That's so sad to hear. No wonder she hasn't replied to my messages. I want to offer my condolences, but I'm worried about bothering her.
Just send her a short message for now, okay? Let her know she doesn't need to reply right away.
